title: Neutral Returns at High-Order Grazing: Sharp Cyclicity, Physical Codimension, and Weighted Crossover
summary: We study a neutral periodic orbit of a continuous two-field flow that is tangent to a switching seam while nearby orbits enter the second field. We separate the roles of two governing integers: the neutral-return order $n\geq2$ controls orbit count, whereas the even contact order $ν$ controls grazing codimension, passage scale, and transverse crossover. Continuity factors the branch mismatch as $X^+-X^-=hW$; an active excursion of duration $O(q^{1/ν})$ therefore produces a correction of order $q_+^{1+1/ν}$.
